## Business summary

Bad Boy Golf Carts is a multi-state golf cart dealership selling discounted new and used golf carts,
low speed vehicles (LSV) and neighborhood electric vehicles (NEV). Inventory is refreshed daily
from the dealer management system. Every listing is available by phone at 1-888-840-4490.

## Answers to common questions

Q: Who is Bad Boy Golf Carts?
A: A golf cart dealership selling discounted new and used golf carts across 11 locations in 7 states, with nationwide delivery. Phone 1-888-840-4490.

Q: How often is inventory updated?
A: Every day. The published inventory snapshot is rebuilt daily from the dealer management system.

Q: Where are you located?
A: Hatfield, PA; Ocean View, NJ; Long Pond, PA; Dover, DE; Scranton, PA; Raleigh, NC; South Bend, IN; Gloucester Point, VA; Bayville Township, NJ; Ocean Township (Waretown), NJ; Lecanto, FL.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes - 0% APR for 48 months on approved credit. Applications are handled through partner lenders linked from the financing page.

Q: Do you deliver?
A: Yes, nationwide delivery is available. Call 1-888-840-4490 for a delivery quote.

Q: What brands do you carry?
A: Club Car, Denago, Evolution.

Q: Are the carts street legal?
A: Some are. 30 units in the current snapshot are titled street legal (LSV). Street legal requirements vary by state.

Q: How do I check the price of a specific cart?
A: Open its page under https://badboygolfcarts.com/golfcart/ or call 1-888-840-4490. Prices shown are the discounted retail price in USD.

Q: Can I buy online?
A: Purchases are completed by phone at 1-888-840-4490; the website is the catalogue.

Q: What is the difference between electric and gas golf carts?
A: Electric carts run on battery packs (lead acid or lithium), are quieter and cheaper to run. Gas carts have a longer range per refuel and higher torque for hills and towing.
